name: produce a full map file per maze in the required output layout
definition: write one output file per maze id, under a shared output directory, with cell markers matching each instance's ground truth.
failure_mode: any missing instance fails the existence check; any mis-layout fails content

name: produce a proof with no admitted obligations
definition: Ensure the final proof uses no admission keywords and terminates with the closing proof command.
failure_mode: Use of admission or missing completion markers fails the scan.

name: profile python scripts via cProfile and read the stats
definition: Run a Python module under cProfile saving a stats file, then read the recorded total runtime to validate the improvement is in the correct band.
failure_mode: If cProfile cannot run the script (import/timeout), no profile is produced and the speed check fails.

name: prove execution by creating marker files on the worker
definition: Make the command create the distinct marker files inside the worker's filesystem, so the outcome is observable/verifiable by the harness's endpoint.
